title: Monthly Arrangement Payments Collected Up Front on Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease Deficiencies
content:
# Cross-Product Credit Bulletin — Monthly Payments Collected Up Front on a TRAC Deficiency Arrangement

**Rule.** For a Kestrel payment arrangement on a TRAC deficiency of a Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease unit, the monthly arrangement payments collected up front are two where two or more late charges were posted on the business's Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contracts within the last 6 whole months, none where none was posted and the business holds an active Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract, and one in every other case.

**Records read.** From the business's Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contracts: the late charges posted on them with their posting dates, and whether any such contract is active. A late charge falls within the last 6 whole months when fewer than 6 whole months separate its posting date from today, whole months being one fewer where today's day of the month is smaller than the posting's.

| Retail late charges within the last 6 whole months | Active Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract held | Monthly payments collected up front |
|---|---|---|
| two or more | any | two (2) |
| exactly one | any | one |
| none | yes | none |
| none | no | one |

## Cases (hypothetical)

1. Two retail late charges posted 1 and 4 whole months ago: two.
2. No retail late charge in the window, an active retail installment contract held: none.
3. No retail late charge in the window, the only retail installment contract paid off: one.
4. One retail late charge posted 2 whole months ago, an active retail installment contract held: one.
